description: This file defines the RouteEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine, responsible for handling routing of service calls within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides implementations for executing services synchronously and asynchronously, as well as sending callbacks.

classes.name: RouteEngine
classes.description: A class that manages routing logic for services, extending GenericAsyncEngine, and providing methods for executing services synchronously and handling callbacks.

methods.name: RouteEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RouteEngine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, returning the validated parameters.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously without returning any result; effectively ignores the output.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Sends callbacks after service execution, with different parameter overloads for handling result, errors, and modes.
